services.title: Residential Roofing
services.short: Repairs, replacements and installation on homes of any size
services.text: Texas weather is unpredictable, and your roof is your home's only protection from it. Our team identifies, assesses and analyzes every area of your roofing system so the work is done quickly and correctly.
services.imageAlt: Two-story home with a finished grey shingle roof
body: Your home is a place where family and friends come to feel safe, share memories, and a place you call your own. Texas is notorious for its unpredictable weather, and when a storm hits, your roof is your home's only protection from harsh elements. Loose shingles and leaks pose huge risks of damage to your valuables, and expensive repairs, and a safety threat to your loved ones.

Whether the damage is hail, rain, wind, extreme heat, hurricanes, or anything in between, DoubleDown Roofing is here to take care of you and your loved ones. Our customers' safety is our top concern and you can trust our contractors to get the job done.

Our team of expert roofers brings integrity, professionalism and accuracy to hundreds of roofing projects, each with a unique home design and its own complexities. No matter how big or small the home, no project is too complex for our roofing team.
points: Roof repair, replacement and new installation
Asphalt shingles, metal roofing and flat roofing
Thorough inspection of the whole roofing system
Full cleanup once the last nail is in

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: A full replacement installed as a CertainTeed Select ShingleMaster
services.text: A roof replacement is not an easy task, and finding a legitimate roofing contractor can be tricky. As a CertainTeed Select ShingleMaster we install factory-sourced materials and register CertainTeed's highest warranties in your name.
services.imageAlt: Roofing crew installing new shingles on a brick home
body: To ensure you are making the best decision for your home, CertainTeed created a professional certification program for contractors who meet strict requirements. It recognizes contractors who meet CertainTeed's highest standards for quality, professionalism and customer service, and only the top 1% of roofing contractors nationwide are certified as Select ShingleMasters. DoubleDown Roofing & Construction LLC is proud to be in that top 1%.

Our contractors only use materials sourced directly from the factory. There are no third-party warehouses, generic products or substitutions. From the first inspection through to after-install service, our team is here to answer any questions or concerns.

Every roofing project is unique, which is why we offer free quotes to all of our clients. Our team will work with you to understand your specific needs and provide a detailed estimate for your project.
points: 10-year workmanship warranty
4-star CertainTeed coverage up to 50 years
Non-prorated coverage for the full term
Materials and labor both covered
Tear-off and disposal costs covered

services.title: Insurance Claim Specialists
services.short: Texas all-lines specialists who handle the claim from first call to closing
services.text: Hail, wind and storm damage is an insurance loss covered by your homeowner's policy. Our team handles the claim process for you, from calling in the new claim to closing it out.
services.imageAlt: Roofing crew working on a residential roof after storm damage
body: Most insurance companies are willing to foot the entire bill, minus your deductible, for the replacement of a damaged roof. The claim is classified as a natural disaster, which means it will not haunt you with future rate increases.

Navigating a claim is frustrating for anyone unfamiliar with the process, and it often leads to receiving less than you deserve. Our team includes dedicated Texas all-lines insurance claims specialists who understand the process and make sure your adjuster is fully informed and prepared to work on your behalf.

We act as your advocate with your homeowners insurance adjuster throughout. Our involvement means you will not end up with a settlement that falls short of covering your costs or, worse, a denial. We handle the detail with your insurance company and are available to meet your adjuster on request.

As part of our success in providing high-quality customer service, we have a longstanding relationship with Texas Windstorm Certification Inspectors to ensure your roof exceeds standard codes and regulations.
points: Zero out-of-pocket expenses besides your deductible or work outside the claim
We meet the adjuster with you and advocate on your behalf
Your project manager reviews the loss statement for accuracy
Storm, hail, wind, fire and flood claims

faqs.q: Is there a way to avoid paying my deductible?
faqs.a: Legally there is no way to avoid paying your deductible. There are contractors willing to falsify documents and invoices, and doing so is insurance fraud that can result in felony charges for the roofing company and the property owner.

faqs.q: What does the claim cost me?
faqs.a: Besides your insurance deductible or any work outside of the claim, you pay zero out-of-pocket expenses.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: Roofing for businesses, from retail stores to restaurants
services.text: We deliver roofing solutions that meet the needs of businesses across a range of industries, with an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau behind the work.
body: When tasked with roofing projects for industry leaders like Walmart and Saltgrass Steakhouse, we approached each job with dedication, meticulous craftsmanship and a commitment to excellence.

For Walmart, with its massive structures and bustling customer activity, we recognized the importance of precision. Every beam, nail and layer of roofing material was installed with care to ensure the integrity and strength of the structure.

With Saltgrass Steakhouse, we took special care to blend functionality with aesthetics. We made sure the structure could withstand weather challenges while upholding the health and safety standards that are critical in the foodservice industry.
Our job doesn't end once the last nail is hammered. We perform a thorough cleanup after each project so no debris is left behind, from removing stray nails to properly disposing of old materials.
points: Retail, restaurant and industrial buildings
A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau
Thorough site cleanup after every project
Commercial roof repair, replacement and restoration

claim.title: How a storm claim works
claim.text: We take the hassle out of the insurance claim process, from calling in the new claim to closing it out.

steps.title: Scheduling an inspection
steps.text: One of our home inspectors conducts a thorough 5-point multi-inspection, documents the damage and takes plenty of photographs and video for your claim.

steps.title: Insurance adjustor meeting
steps.text: Let us know your appointment time. One of our team members meets you and the adjuster to answer questions and point out every area of damage.

steps.title: The closing
steps.text: Our project manager reviews the adjuster's evaluation so all damage is fairly evaluated, then comes out for a shingle presentation and an overview of project expenses.

steps.title: Paperwork and final payment
steps.text: We stand behind our work and offer a satisfaction guarantee on all of our services.
